discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: After AI/neural networks (2024) and macroscopic quantum tunnelling in superconducting circuits (2025), the committee is likely to turn back to condensed matter. Topological insulators are a mature, field-defining discovery: Kane and Mele's Z2 theory of the quantum spin Hall state (2005) and Molenkamp's 2007 experimental confirmation in HgTe quantum wells. Both have already been recognized with the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver E. Buckley prizes. The 2016 Nobel for topological phases cleared the way, and with Shoucheng Zhang deceased the trio is clean.
